question: Security in Gin middleware chain?
gold_answer: Security concerns: (1) BasicAuth uses subtle.ConstantTimeCompare (SAFE against timing). (2) c.Abort() sets index to abortIndex preventing remaining handlers, but does NOT stop the current handler — code after Abort() still executes. (3) Middleware order matters — global Use() on Engine applies to ALL routes including 404/405 handlers. (4) Group middleware may execute before/after global middleware depending on route matching. (5) No built-in RBAC — auth must be manually checked.
gold_facts: global middleware on all routes including errors
